subject: f-t7 QA tasks complete: arena dark, light mode, responsive 375/768
body:
GP,

All 3 T7 QA tasks complete. Commit c59d2e7.

arena-dark-mode-qa.test.js: 15/15
  - shared/styles.css body.arena-mode block verified (--bg-*, --text-*, --accent-*)
  - scripts.js arena toggle + mcm-arena-mode localStorage key confirmed
  - no stale 'arena-mode' key in production pages
  - prefers-color-scheme:dark auto-apply confirmed

light-mode-checklist.test.js: 18/18
  - All 7 required :root tokens in shared/styles.css
  - Production pages (index, exam) link shared/styles.css
  - Design prototypes correctly self-styled (no unexpected dependency)
  - --bg-page luminance 238/255 (light: #F4F5F9 confirmed)

responsive-375-768.test.js: 18/18
  - shared CSS has 768px tablet + 375px phone breakpoints confirmed
  - pointer:coarse + 44px touch targets found
  - All 6 key pages have viewport meta tag
  - 2 warnings: scorecard.html/scorecard-2.html are flex-only (acceptable for FD prototypes)

All 3 exit 0. Release gate still 19/19.

- GF
